name: Tommy John Schiavoni
bottom_line: A light incumbent page made up mostly of endorsement excerpts. The basic facts check out. Its record claims come from editorials and carry no bill numbers or amounts.
findings: First Assembly term from January 2025 is confirmed; he succeeded Fred Thiele.
Funding and legislation claims are quoted from endorsing papers, not documented.
page_issues: No bill numbers or dollar figures for "key funding".
